name: install_darkseed_to_hard_drive

description: Calls the library function at offset minus 48 from the library base held in the address register and returns with no other work.

name: copy_command_tools_to_ram
description: Runs six command-line steps through the library vector at offset minus 222: copies the cd, copy, delete, execute and makedir tools into the RAM disk, then runs the cd tool from there.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:02EA
name: delete_ram_command_tools
description: Runs five commands through the library vector at offset minus 222 that delete the cd, copy, delete, execute and makedir tools from the RAM disk.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:031E
name: read_typed_line_with_backspace
description: Reads keystrokes into a buffer, keeping digits, letters and y or n answers, removing the last character on backspace and ending the string when return is pressed.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:03EA
name: write_marker_file_with_suffix
description: Builds a file path from a base name and a fixed string, then opens, writes and closes a file at that path, repeating the steps for a second path with a different suffix.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0E8A
name: retry_checks_four_times
description: Runs a pair of checks up to four times, returning the index of the first attempt where both pass, or minus one if all four attempts fail.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0EDE
name: run_device_request_raster_wait
description: Sends a device request through library calls; if the unit's flag is already set it waits about 900 raster polls, then clears the flag and returns the request result, while on failure it sets the flag and returns minus one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0EE2
name: open_trackdisk_and_request_io
description: Calls the library routines that open the trackdisk device and send it an I/O request, waiting about 900 raster polls first when the unit's flag is set; on failure it sets the flag and returns minus one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0FA8

description: Calls two library routines, then compares two long words and one word of a table entry, selected by the index argument, against stored values, returning zero on a match or minus one otherwise.

name: compare_table_entry_fields

name: compare_table_entry_fields
description: Calls two library routines, then compares two long words and one word of a table entry, selected by the index argument, against stored values, returning zero on a match or minus one otherwise.

name: compare_table_entry_fields
description: Calls two library routines, then compares two long words and one word of a table entry, selected by the index argument, against stored values, returning zero on a match or minus one otherwise.

name: lock_examine_and_compare_volume
description: Locks and examines a dos volume named darkseed_1 or df0, unlocks it, then runs the same table-entry field comparison as its neighbours and returns zero when the fields match.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0000
name: build_display_list_and_loop
description: Checks the current task, fills a table of hardware display register words from a fixed source, then loops handling input characters and message-port events until its exit condition.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0040
name: open_three_system_libraries
description: Opens three system libraries in sequence and stores their bases; when all three open it calls one further library routine on the last base, and when an open fails it releases the libraries already opened.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:00A6
name: return_without_action
description: Returns straight away without doing any work, so it serves as a no-op target for calls and hooks.

name: release_saved_system_resources
description: Checks a setup flag and, when it is set, calls the release routine on two saved handles in turn.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0362
name: find_key_entry_and_flag
description: Scans a table of sixteen-byte entries for a two-character key, stopping at a terminator entry, and on a match sets the entry's flag bit, marks the handler as active and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:036A
name: mark_handler_active_flag
description: Sets the active bit in a control block, makes an extra library call when a stored character is J, then marks the handler as active before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:03C4
name: store_byte_into_object_fields
description: Calls one routine, then writes a single byte value into three fields of the record the address register points to, at offsets 9, 10 and 54.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0824
name: toggle_display_pointer_for_frame
description: Flips a toggle flag, selects one of two stored pointers based on the previous flag value, and adds 44 to that pointer when bit 15 of the vertical position register is set.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0870
name: pass_through_routine_result
description: Calls one routine and then returns the data-register value that was already set on entry.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:087C
name: update_frame_state_machine
description: Advances a frame counter and dispatches on a state byte and timer value to update object coordinates, flags and clamp limits, calling out to several routines to apply the result.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0A9C
name: set_bit_when_source_set
description: Sets the low flag bit in a second record when the low flag bit in a first record is already set, and leaves the second record unchanged otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0ADC
name: toggle_flag_bits_for_index
description: Toggles bit 4 in the table entry chosen by the index argument, and when a mode value equals 10 also toggles bit 0 of the record that entry points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0B84
name: return_without_action
description: Returns straight away without doing any work, so it serves as a no-op target for calls and hooks.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0BBE
name: split_value_into_quotient_remainder
description: Returns zero when the value is below a threshold; otherwise it returns two packed words, the remainder of dividing the value by 3600 and the quotient minus 18.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0C44
name: lookup_byte_from_offset_table
description: Adds a byte to a table value selected by an index, multiplies the sum by nine, and returns the byte stored at that position in a lookup table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0C78
name: copy_record_into_fixed_storage
description: Clears a flag, copies the leading fields of a source record into fixed storage, then sets a state byte to 1.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CC2
name: set_control_bits_follow_up
description: Sets fixed bit masks in a control word and in an indexed entry, then when the timer is past its threshold runs follow-up calls chosen by a stored code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CC8
name: set_entry_bits_follow_up
description: Sets fixed bit masks in an indexed entry, then when the timer is past its threshold runs follow-up calls chosen by a stored code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CCE
name: run_timer_follow_up
description: When a timer value is past its threshold, runs follow-up calls chosen by a stored code: three calls for one code and one call for another.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D02
name: clear_low_flag_bit
description: Calls one routine, then clears the lowest flag bit in the record the address register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D12
name: set_low_flag_bit
description: Calls one routine, then sets the lowest flag bit in the record the address register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D22
name: toggle_low_flag_bit
description: Calls one routine, then toggles the lowest flag bit in the record the address register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D3E
name: update_moving_object_state
description: Updates a moving object's direction and motion flags from its current coordinates and input flags, adjusting its speed fields and calling helpers to apply the change.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0FD6
name: return_without_action
description: Returns straight away without doing any work, so it serves as a no-op target for calls and hooks.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:10C4
name: set_position_derived_value
description: Stores two words into an object record's position fields, then computes a further field as a base value minus a multiplier times one sixth of an input offset.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1164
name: store_value_and_flag_bit
description: Clears the top flag bit of a record, and when the value exceeds four sets that bit and subtracts four; then it stores the value plus 24 into three fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1190
name: find_free_grid_cell
description: Steps a candidate point toward a reference point by per-axis increments until it lands on a grid cell whose bit is clear in a bitmap, then returns that point.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:120E
name: pick_nearest_unmarked_point
description: Computes the distance from each stored point to a reference point, repeatedly picks the nearest point not yet marked in a bit set, marks it and updates the stored coordinates until the count is exhausted.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1306
name: search_free_cell_by_steps
description: Computes the absolute x and y distances between two points, picks two per-axis step sizes from their ratio, and searches toward the target until it finds a grid cell whose bit is clear.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1352
name: halve_step_sizes_when_close
description: Sets a flag byte, and when a stored coordinate is under 741 it calls a routine and then, if it is under 351, halves the two step-size bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:136A
name: halve_both_step_sizes
description: Shifts two step-size bytes right by one bit each, halving them, and returns the data-register value unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1384
name: spiral_search_for_free_cell
description: Returns the current point unchanged when a flag is set; otherwise it spirals outward from a point in steps of four, checking the grid bitmap within bounds until it finds a clear cell or reaches its step limit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1430
name: remove_table_entries_by_key
description: Marks every table entry whose first byte matches the key argument as removed, then updates a flag bit and copies a field between two records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1458
name: restore_removed_table_entries
description: Scans the same table and replaces every removed marker with the key byte, then calls two routines if any entry was restored.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1486
name: reset_mode_positions_clear_table
description: Clears a flag bit in every eight-byte record, sets two position fields from a mode value of 0 to 3, and when the mode is 3 zeroes forty-two entries of a table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1522
name: call_then_set_status_bits
description: Calls one routine, then sets bits 2 and 3 in a byte of the record the address register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1546
name: load_fixed_timers_set_state
description: Calls a set of helper routines, updates record fields, loads fixed timer values and sets the state to 2.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:15BA
name: double_table_byte_and_add
description: Looks up a byte in a table at an index offset of 152, doubles it, and adds the result to the incoming value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:15D8
name: dispatch_command_by_code
description: Dispatches on a command byte, running a different sequence of helper calls and state updates for each code, and for message codes it walks a byte sequence until its terminator, translating one marker to a carriage return.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1B16
name: toggle_flag_then_notify
description: Calls one routine, toggles the lowest bit of the byte the address register points to, then passes that pointer to a second routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2098
name: cycle_frame_indices_on_record
description: Writes the values 29, 30 and 29 in turn into one byte field of two records, with routine calls between the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:20BC
name: wait_forever_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then loops forever without returning, so control never leaves this path.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:20CC
name: toggle_control_block_flag
description: Calls one routine, then toggles the lowest bit of a byte in a fixed control block.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:20DE
name: clear_flag_wait_until_zero
description: Clears a flag byte and then busy-waits until the incoming value reaches zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2106
name: reset_state_and_set_fields
description: Resets a state byte and calls a routine when it is neither zero nor four, then clears a flag bit and sets three fields of a record to 28.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:213E
name: show_end_text_and_halt
description: Sets a bit in a record, runs a sequence of helper calls for the closing text, then loops forever so the program never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2230
name: dispatch_display_setup_or_update
description: For an index below 32 it runs a display setup sequence, copies a block of five long words and then loops forever; otherwise it updates a stored value when it differs from the current one and issues follow-up calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2282
name: call_two_then_loop_forever
description: Calls two routines and then loops forever without returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:232C
name: initialise_record_from_source_position
description: Copies the position fields of one record into another, sets its flag and a fixed value of 1000 at offset 38, then toggles its flags and calls routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:239A
name: shift_flag_and_copy_position
description: Shifts a flag byte in one record left by two and combines it with its original value, copies a word field between two records, and clears two state bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:23C4
name: shift_flag_and_copy_position
description: Shifts a flag byte in one record left by two and combines it with its original value, copies a word field between two records, and clears two state bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:23FA
name: find_entry_by_third_byte
description: Scans a table of three-byte records for the key byte stored in the third position, stopping at the terminator record, and returns once a match is found.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2418
name: append_value_to_recent_list
description: Calls one routine, writes a marker value of 254 into a slot, appends the incoming value to a list of recent values, sets a counter to zero or six less than the list length, and advances the list index.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2446
name: remove_value_from_recent_list
description: Calls one routine, clears a slot, searches the same list for the incoming value, and when found shifts the later entries down over it, decrements the list count and adjusts the counter.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:248C
name: shift_flag_and_copy_position
description: Shifts a flag byte in one record left by two and combines it with its original value, copies a word field between two records, and clears two state bytes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2494
name: clear_state_flags_after_call
description: Clears bit 4 in a state byte and the lowest bit in a record, then calls one routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:24B0
name: initialise_two_handler_slots
description: Marks a handler as active, clears a flag and a field of a control block, then writes the values 65 and 66 into a field of two further records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:24B4
name: initialise_two_handler_slots
description: Marks a handler as active, clears a flag and a field of a control block, then writes the values 65 and 66 into a field of two further records.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx][a](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX][a](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:2508
